scope: Complete pretrained shape flow, 512 synthetic active voxels, stock LoRA and complex RoPE. Same seed, original FP32 CPU reference, mixed-precision PJRT, synchronized input/output transfers. One run per setting, five warm calls.
lowering_evidence: Hardware kernel inventory contains two SDPA compute specializations (self/cross shapes); baseline inventory used standalone softmax. The inventory lists compiled specializations, not per-call timing.
decision: Keep default unchanged. Fused attention is operational and about 4.4% faster at this size, but total relative error increases substantially. The large RoPE layout cost remains the profiling priority. Operator smoke pass is not trajectory or scene-quality acceptance.
